description: UIM Application Autoscaler — scaling policies, rules, schedules, metrics and scaling history of bound applications

scopes.name: $XSAPPNAME.Read
scopes.description: Read bindings, policies, rules, schedules, metrics and the scaling history

scopes.name: $XSAPPNAME.Operate
scopes.description: Submit metrics, run evaluations, scale manually, suspend and resume autoscaling

scopes.name: $XSAPPNAME.Manage
scopes.description: Maintain bindings, policies, rules and schedules; attach and detach policies

scopes.name: $XSAPPNAME.Admin
scopes.description: Manage the user accounts of the built-in login (not used with XSUAA)

role-templates.name: ScalingAdministrator
role-templates.description: Maintain policies, rules, schedules and bindings; operate
